# Gapdb storage v1 fixture provenance

The hexadecimal fixtures in this directory are generated by the independent,
field-by-field contract encoders in `golden_test.go`. They pin the exact v1
identity, manifest, WAL, and incomplete-tail bytes without marshaling Gapdb's
production persistence structs.

Regeneration is an explicit developer action:

```sh
go test ./tests/compatibility/storage -run '^TestStorageGoldenFixtures$' -update-storage-goldens
```

Review the resulting byte diff and run the normal compatibility and full test
suites before committing it. Routine tests never rewrite fixtures.
